questions.question: Bone growth is influenced maximally by:
questions.explanation: Growth hormone has the greatest influence on bone growth, acting with IGF-1.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Essential Orthopedics/Maheshwari/3rd Ed./Pg. 265

questions.question: Physiological neonatal jaundice is caused due to:
questions.explanation: Physiological neonatal jaundice is due to immaturity of hepatic conjugation (glucuronyl transferase).
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/A. K. Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 81

questions.question: The life span of a red blood cell is:
questions.explanation: The red cell life span is about 120 days.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/A. K. Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 47

questions.question: The volume of urine excreted by a healthy adult is:
questions.explanation: A healthy adult excretes about 1500-2000 mL of urine per day.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/A. K. Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 560

questions.question: A therapist employed in a nursing home routinely treats patients in excess of 70 years of age. Which of the following physical changes is not associated with aging?
questions.explanation: With ageing residual volume rises and vital capacity falls, but total lung capacity stays about the same.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Mcardle/4th Ed./Pg. 222

questions.question: Physical activity has been hypothesized to decrease the occurrence and severity of coronary artery disease. Which of the following does not occur as a result a regular training program?

options.A: An increase in coronary collateral vascularisation
options.B: An increase in serum triglyceride level
options.C: An increase in red blood cell mass and blood volume

questions.explanation: Regular training lowers, not raises, serum triglycerides.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation/Sullivan/5th Ed./Pg 609

questions.question: Conduction of nerve impulse is a factor in myelinated nerves because of:
questions.explanation: Myelinated fibres conduct impulses by saltatory conduction between nodes of Ranvier.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Ptm chapter

questions.question: Negativity of resting membrane potential is due to:

options.A: Potassium is more permeable than sodium
options.B: Three sodium ejected for two potassium
options.C: Potassium is brought into the cell and sodium expelled out of the cell

questions.explanation: The resting potential is negative because of high K+ permeability, the Na+/K+ pump (3 Na out, 2 K in) and impermeant intracellular anions.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Agent in Rehabilitation/2nd Ed./Pg.85

questions.question: Nonmyelinated fibers are:
questions.explanation: C fibres are the unmyelinated, slowest conducting fibres.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Medical Physiology Vol -1/ A.K. Jain/3rd Ed./Pg.150

questions.question: 1 liter of oxygen expanded is equivalent to how much calories?
questions.explanation: One litre of oxygen consumed releases about 5 kcal (4.8) of energy.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Guyton/Pg. 793

questions.question: The sinus node acts as the cardiac pacemaker in the heart. The sinus node is a group of cardiac cells that discharges an impulse. Where is the sinus node located in the heart?
questions.explanation: The sinoatrial node lies in the wall of the right atrium near the entry of the superior vena cava.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy B. D. Chaurasia/4th Ed./Pg. 245

questions.question: You are in physiology class studying the difference between erythrocytes and leukocytes in the body. Each one has a primary function to perform so that the body functions normally. Which of the following would be a primary function of erythrocytes in the body?
questions.explanation: Erythrocytes transport oxygen (and carbon dioxide) via haemoglobin.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Physiology and Biochemistry/A. K. Jain/ 2nd Ed./Pg. 35

questions.question: The resting membrane potential of skeletal muscle fiber is:
questions.explanation: Resting potential of skeletal muscle is minus 90 mV.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 167

questions.question: Conduction of nerve impulses is faster in myelinated nerves because of:
questions.explanation: Myelinated nerves conduct faster by saltatory conduction.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 167

questions.question: Cardiac muscles ability to regenerate is:
questions.explanation: Cardiac muscle has no regenerative ability.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 189

questions.question: Presence of muscle fibrillation indicates which of the following?
questions.explanation: Fibrillation indicates loss of muscle innervation.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Neurology and Neurosurgery/Illustrated/Lindsay/Pg. 57

questions.question: During rest the flow of blood to muscle is:
questions.explanation: Resting muscle blood flow is about 3-4 mL per 100 g per minute.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Approximately/Macardle/4th Ed./Pg. 316

questions.question: Coughing is usually considered a reflex controlled by afferent stimulation of the:
questions.explanation: The afferent limb of the cough reflex is carried by the vagus nerve.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Pg. 472

questions.question: The normal breath holding time in a normal young individual is:
questions.explanation: Normal breath-holding time in a young adult is about 45-55 seconds.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Pg. 481

questions.question: In deep inspiration the central tendon of diaphragm is drawn downwards by:
questions.explanation: In deep inspiration the diaphragm descends about 7 cm.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Mcardle/4th Ed.Pg. 86

questions.question: The normal residual volume of air in lungs is
questions.explanation: Residual volume is about 1200 mL.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Pg. 436

questions.question: The duration of normal cardiac cycle is:
questions.explanation: At a rate of about 75 per minute the cardiac cycle lasts about 0.8 s.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/Pg. 297

questions.question: In ECG "QRS" complex represents

options.B: Atrial repolarization and closure of semilunar valves
options.C: Ventricular repolarization and opening of semilunar valves
options.D: Ventricular depolarization and it precedes ventricular systole

questions.explanation: The QRS complex represents ventricular depolarization.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/3rd Ed./Pg. 304

questions.question: The speed of conduction of impulse in a nerve fiber depends upon:
questions.explanation: Conduction velocity increases with fibre diameter and myelination.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/

3rd Ed./Pg. 1490

questions.question: Rhesus (Rh) factor is positive in:
questions.explanation: About 85 percent of people are Rh positive.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter:
Cited reference: Textbook of Physiology/AK Jain/

for PT and OT/4th Ed./Pg. 61

questions.question: A therapist observes a patient's breathing as part of a respiratory assessment. Which muscle of respiration most active during expiration?
questions.explanation: Internal intercostals are the muscles most active in forced expiration.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Human Anatomy/Vol. 1/BDC/4th Ed./Pg. 207

questions.question: A therapist revises literature which details the expected changes in endurance and physical work capacity as an individual progress from middle age to an older adult. Which or the following measurements would not be affected by this transition?
questions.explanation: Resting heart rate changes little with age, whereas maximum heart rate and cardiac output fall.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation/Sullivan/5th Ed./Pg. 601

questions.question: A physical therapist studies a normal resting electrocardiogram for one cardiac cycle. What wave or change in shape of the electrocardiogram results from atrial depolarization?
questions.explanation: The P wave represents atrial depolarization.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Cited reference: Physical Rehabilitation/Sullivan/5th Ed./Pg. 603

questions.question: Skeletal muscles in a normal adult contribute:

options.A: 10 to 15% to the total body weight
options.B: 15 to 20% to the total body weight
options.C: 40 to 50% to the total body weight
options.D: 0 to 5% to the total body weight

questions.explanation: Skeletal muscle forms about 40-50 percent of adult body weight.
questions.sourceBook: Suraj Kumar, MCQs for MPT Entrance Examination (2nd ed., Jaypee 2020)
questions.sourceChapter: Biomech chapter
